change: Guard createPortal with typeof document !== undefined so Node SSR does not evaluate the portal or its document.body fallback.

observations.claim: When document is absent, the guard evaluates false and JavaScript short-circuiting skips createPortal and evaluation of its container argument. typeof is safe on an undeclared identifier.
Remaining document listeners are inside useEffect. React server rendering does not run those effects. createPortal import is preserved but no server invocation occurs.
In a normal browser document exists, so the portal expression, its control-chat/body target, submit isolation, showModal/close effects and focus handlers are the same as in committed parent89c6069.
The existing package-upgrade test imports react-dom/server.node and calls renderToString(createElement(App)); SSR compatibility is an existing repository check, not a hypothetical product expansion.
This follow-up does not change request payload, backend routes, model selection, retrieval, authorization, network or generation code.
